title: re-quantization floorplanner + KV-aware runqueue and prefetcher
author: Maya Chen
description: Motivation: live inference at scale shows two correlated costs: (1) token-level skew across heads causes uneven dequantization pressure and kernel underutilization; (2) KV cache prefetches that ignore imminently requantizable layers waste memory bandwidth. This PR introduces a runqueue floorplanner that groups requests by head-wise dynamic range and routes them to a KV-aware prefetcher that schedules dequant/requant operations to minimize memory traffic and kernel stalls. Design summary: (a) quant_floorplanner: lightweight per-worker planner that buckets requests by per-head scale metrics collected from the model profiler (no model changes); (b) kv_prefetcher: async prefetcher that coordinates KV windowing with the floorplanner to avoid double dequant for tokens that will be requantized downstream; (c) hybrid_requant_path: runtime switch that chooses between microkernel-level requantization (fast path) and fused dequant+requant (memory-savings path) based on current bandwidth headroom; (d) continuous_batcher integration: the floorplanner exposes hints to the continuous batcher so batches have better homogeneity for INT8 microkernels. Checklist: - [x] microbench harness and unit tests for planner and prefetcher - [x] perf benchmarks across A6000 and H100 profiles - [x] regression evals on prompt set A/B - [x] feature-flag gated and telemetry (new metrics: floorplan_bins, kv_prefetch_misses, requant_path_ratio) Backwards compatibility: feature-flag default=false; no API surface changes. Benchmarks (representative): - A6000, LlamaX-13B-INT8: throughput +17% p95 latency -9% p50 latency - H100, LlamaX-70B-FP8/INT8 hybrid: throughput +19% p50 latency -12% Accuracy/regression: automated evals on 1200 prompts show mean token-perplexity delta <0.2% (within tolerance). Risk and rollout plan: start with internal Dedicated fleet at 10% traffic, monitor new metrics and script automated rollback on kv_prefetch_misses > 0.5% or requant_path_ratio deviating >20% from expectation. Release notes: improves quantized-path throughput and KV efficiency for INT8/FP8 workloads; gated behind "requant-floorplanner" feature flag.
